title: Organiser FAQ: first marathon — PPS medical document, lockers, toilets, pacers, headphones, medal
publisher: A.S.O. — Schneider Electric Marathon de Paris official website
claims: Since 2024 the medical certificate has been replaced: runners complete the online Health Prevention Pathway (PPS) or upload an FFA license; the Attestation PPS PDF is valid for 3 months and must be uploaded to the timeto account.
Luggage lockers are available on Avenue Foch from 7 a.m.; bags must be no larger than 45×36×20 cm, carry the luggage label from the bib envelope, and are retrieved by showing the race number.
Toilets are available at the start, finish and next to feed stations; no showers are provided.

Headphones are allowed; accompanying runners without a bib are not allowed alongside or across the finish; live tracking is provided; pacers are assigned to each corral and coaches lead group warm-up in the start pens.
The cut-off is 6 hours after the last runner starts; finishers receive a finisher's medal after crossing the finish.
The FAQ-level refreshment description says refreshment points and toilets are available every 5 km.
